ov: تحليل جريمة قتل (الإنجليزية: Anatomy of a Murder) هو فيلم جريمة تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1959. الفيلم من إخراج أوتو بريمنغر.
plotEn:
In the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, small-town lawyer Paul Biegler, a former district attorney who lost his re-election bid, spends most of his time fishing, playing the piano, and hanging out with his alcoholic friend and colleague Parnell McCarthy and sardonic secretary Maida Rutledge.
Laura Manion contacts Biegler to defend her husband, US Army Lieutenant Frederick "Manny" Manion, arrested for the murder of innkeeper Bernard "Barney" Quill. Manion does not deny the murder but claims Quill raped his wife. Even with the rape  motivation, Biegler believes getting Manion cleared of murder will be difficult. Manion claims to have no memory of the event, which suggests he may be eligible for a defense of irresistible impulse—a version of a temporary insanity defense. It is strongly implied that Manion is faking insanity, guided to it as a potential defense by Biegler in his questioning.
Biegler's folksy speech and laid-back demeanor hide a sharp legal mind and a propensity for courtroom theatrics that keeps the judge busy maintaining control. The case for the defense does not go well, however, especially as local district attorney Mitch Lodwick is assisted by high-powered prosecutor Claude Dancer from the Attorney General's office.
